notes.title: 3DF Zephyr 4.500 released!
notes.content:
[b]Good news, everyone![/b]


[b]3DF Zephyr 4.500[/b] is ready for download!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11732295/20a63f44fe805c513b3b27ebd241e03d85dee83c.jpg[/img]

So what’s new? A lot of improvements, as usual, in both the core technology and the user experience as well!

This major update took a little longer than you’re used to, but we really think it was worth the wait!

The core technology now yields even better results than before, with an all-new detail enhancement filter for mesh, a new UV-packing algorithm, and much more!

The user experience is also improved significantly with a lot of new tools and improvements, such as the option to generate normal maps and displacement maps directly in 3DF Zephyr.
 

Changelog:
[list][*]Better detail extraction during the mvs/mesh extraction[/*][*]The mesh enhancement filter has been improved to extract more details[/*][*]The multiview stereo has been speeded up further[/*][*]Better UV packing algorithm during texture generation[/*][*]Raised internal resolution (The single image resolution can now be bigger)[/*][*]All our core libraries for (3D engine, Math, GUI) have been updated to the latest version with several bug fixes.[/*][*]In order to optimize the computation, mesh and dense point cloud will be computed one shot by default. It will be still possible to generate a separate point cloud if needed.[/*][*]New General preset category suitable for most cases[/*][*]The texturing generation page now have presets as the other pages[/*][*]You can bake normals maps (Object and Tangent space) starting from a high poly mesh to any textured mesh.[/*][*]All the workspace elements can be now moved up or down and organized in any order[/*][*]The alignment tools dialog has been reorganized for better usage[/*][*]3Dconnexion mouse support[/*][*]Corrected an issue and improved the flat shading rendering shader[/*][*]The “Copy all” command in Masquerade now works instantly[/*][*]Added an option to extract all the frames from a video sequence[/*][*]Up to 10x faster frames from video extraction[/*][*]Fixed a bug in the keypoints animator[/*][*]Degenerate tetrahedra management has been improved, and it will lead to a better meshing in some cases[/list]

notes.title: 3DF Zephyr 4.300 out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11732295/4bb57462dbf0b27c054a0e3f1653a04ec4e9c826.png[/img]

[b]Good news, everyone![/b]

3DF Zephyr 4.300 is out now!

[b]Faster processing[/b] - both the Structure from Motion and the Multiview stereo phases have been significantly improved: for the SfM phase, the bundle adjustment has been improved for dealing with very big datasets and the speedup is especially significant when using more than 500 photos during the orientation phase. As for the MvS phase, the depth map generation was the slower part of the pipeline and we have improved it a lot using novel techniques.

[b]Better detail[/b] - Our multiview stereo routine has been improved in several parts and it can recover even more detail than before. Improvements have also been made in the photoconsistency algorithm, which can now deal better with thin structures.

[b]Knife cut tool[/b] - You can now cut through mesh triangles using planes (or bounding box) for a much more beautiful results

[b]Improved UI[/b] and new bounding box - Many tools have been reorganized for a much more efficient workflow and an even cleaner UI design - to top it off, 4.3 also features a new improved bounding box and gizmo.

[b]Export self-hosted 3d model[/b] - Quickly embed your 3D model on your website using this HTML/JS exporter.

[b]CUDA 10.0[/b] - Zephyr has been upgraded to use the latest NVIDIA CUDA toolkit, 10.0. This allows supporting the most recent cards. Please note that with this improvement, the support to older cards (CUDA capabilities < 3.0) has been dropped. Make sure to update your drivers!

Please note that if you are using a very old NVIDIA card, you should still have better performance now even in CPU (when compared to very old nvidia cards). If you have any question on this matter, simply contact support@3dflow.net

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uGO2ex_GsaY]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uGO2ex_GsaY[/url]


[b]Full changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Large dataset Bundle adjustment support (SfM Speedup)
[*] Depth map generation speedups (MvS speedup)
[*] Depth map generation quality improved
[*] Improved thin structures extraction
[*] Knife cut tool
[*] Bindable keys
[*] Improved UV viewer
[*] Improved orientation
[*] Bounding box selection
[*] New bounding box
[*] New dock for selection and editing
[*] Select cameras from 3D
[*] Update to Cuda 10.0
[*] Better generate enhanced mesh behavior
[*] Export self-hosted 3d model
[*] Allowed export texture images only
[*] Limit rendering
[*] Batch tool can load .zep
[*] Color comparison
[*] Quick orientation tools don't change the scale
[*] Detection of masks with different sizes
[*] Mask auto propagation during sfm
[*] Faster Mask by color
[*] Fixed youtube upload with new API
[*] Added button to switch to the rendering system
[*] Heic image support
[*] Added wrml exporter
[/list]

notes.title: 3DF Zephyr 3.5 is ready for download!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11732295/e6fc7850f17c7f79a30c465c38dd5987bfccee3f.jpg[/img]

We’re very excited about v3.5 and we’re sure you will love it too!

[h1]What’s new in this release?[/h1]

This release focused in merging major technology improvements that have been developed for a while in our office. With the addition of our 
[b]hyperplane matching technology[/b] in our MvS pipeline, 3DF Zephyr is now even more accurate than ever. The same can be said about our [b]texturing algorithm[/b], that has been improved a lot as well as other many internal optimizations.

3DF Zephyr is the complete photogrammetry software solution, and with v3.5, it’s even more complete than ever!

As usual, we also improved our existing tools and added a lot of new important features as well: being able to export texture in [b]exr/tiff[/b] has been one of the most requested features in the last few months, and we’re happy to have that too in v3.5!

Other tools worth mentioning are the fan-favourite frames [b]extraction from video[/b] (that has been improved witha better UI), a new [b]shader system[/b] (you can also write your own shaders, too!), full [b]unicode support[/b], [b]point cloud filters[/b] and much, much more!

The full changelog of Zephyr 3.500 is the following:

[list]
[*] Structure from Motion improvements
[*] Multiview stereo significant improvements
[*] Added Hyperplane matching
[*] MVS Final voting phase speed-up
[*] Texturing improvements
[*] New shader system with custom shader editor for mesh and textured meshes
[*] Improved frames extraction from video
[*] Improved 4k UI support
[*] Added 4k video export support
[*] Added kmz – LOD export
[*] Added Full Unicode support (also file loading and object names)
[*] Added Autopath creation from all cameras in animation
[*] Added two new point cloud filters (noise/distance, plane fitting)
[*] Texture can now be generated and exported in 16bit (exr) or 32bit (tiff)
[*] Improved dense point cloud post processing and coloring
[*] Improved obj import speed
[*] It is now possible to disable coloring to speed up processing
[*] It is now possible to use unified and persistent cache folder
[*] It is now possible to zoom/reset view on a specific object
[*] It is now possible to drag and drop an entire folder to load 3D models
[*] Better memory management when loading image of very big size ( >50 Megapixels)
[*] Fixed a problem with synthetic bubble views
[*] Fixed a crash during surface extraction
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometime crash zephyr when applying filters
[*] Fixed many other minor bugs
[*] Fixed DNG white balance issue
[*] Preset tweaks
[*] Minor ui fixes
[*] Miscellaneous fixes
[/list]

notes.title: 3DF Zephyr 3.300 is out now!
notes.content:
[b]Good news, everyone!![/b]

[b]3DF Zephyr 3.300 is finally ready![/b]

As usual, we pushed our state of the art technology to the next level, added new tools and fixed many minor annoying bugs!

What's new in 3.300?
[list]
 	[*][b]Improved technology[/b][/*]
[/list]
This update allowed us to release many speed optimizations we have been developing for a while: our multiview stereo algorithm is now usually 50% faster compared to v3.201 (especially increasing the number of pictures, as it is optimized for big datasets). Our structure from motion algorithm has also been improved, with a faster (and even more accurate) rematching phase  as well as our photoconsistency based optimization. Did we sacrifice accuracy? Of course we did not! In fact, v.3.300 is also even more accurate than ever before!
[list]
 	[*][b]New tools[/b][/*]
[/list]
We always listen to feedback and we managed to sneak in many new tools that should streamline your workflow even more. You can now for example apply mesh filters on mesh selection (for example, you can optimize the topology of a certain part of a mesh). There was also room for other fixes and improvements, as usual: see the log below for more information!
[list]
 	[*][b]Summer Steam Sale![/b][/*]
[/list]
Of course 3DF Zephyr is also part of the traditional Steam Summer Sale! You can get 3DF Zephyr Lite (Steam Edition) with a [b]33% discount[/b]! Head over to our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/438450/3DF_Zephyr_Lite_Steam_Edition/]Steam Page[/url] to purchase it while the offer lasts, and don't forget to share your reconstruction in the community hub :)


Full changelog:
[list]
 	[*]Improved optimize camera parameters and alignment to control points worflows on failure (problematic cameras are now detected and can be removed from the dialog).[/*]
 	[*]Rematching can now be cancelled or paused during bundle adjustment and alignment steps.[/*]
 	[*]Zephyr can now be deactivated also if you are offline. (Non Steam only)[/*]
 	[*]Stereo improvements and preset balancing[/*]
 	[*]Photconsistency mesh optimization speed improvements[/*]
 	[*]Selection tools improvements[/*]
 	[*]Camera positions can now be added as control points[/*]
 	[*]Stereo texture can now been unstructured[/*]
 	[*]Added image overlap in the processing report[/*]
 	[*]Gizmo can now move entire objects only in rendering[/*]
 	[*]Added chinese language support[/*]
 	[*]Sparse point cloud generation improvements (rematching accuracy improved)[/*]
 	[*]Stereo point cloud generation improvements (speed and accuracy)[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug during mesh generation (small parts are reconstructed better now)[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug in stereo point cloud generation[/*]
 	[*]Improved sketchfab upload[/*]
 	[*]Log and System info are now available as separate window from the progress bar[/*]
 	[*]added mesh filtering on selection (laplacian, bilateral, retopology)[/*]
 	[*]added triangle selection filtering by connected components[/*]
 	[*]elements name are now customizable (i.e. create a control point with "CP" label rather than "Control Point")[/*]
 	[*]Added clear cache button and additional memory checks[/*]
 	[*]Update Ogre Engine[/*]
 	[*]Added option to toggle rendering "fog"[/*]
 	[*]Impoved rematching phase[/*]
 	[*]miscellaneous bug fixes[/*]
[/list]

3DF Zephyr is as usual available as Free and Lite over the Steam Platform.

More information are available at [url=http://zephyr.3dflow.net]http://zephyr.3dflow.net [/url]

notes.title: Happy Pi Day! Enjoy the release of Zephyr 3.141!
notes.content:
Happy Pi Day!

To celebrate, we have released 3DF Zephyr 3.141! *

+ Added hardware monitor window
+ Fixed a bug in sketchfab export
+ Fixed a bug in remeshing with no cameras loaded in export
+ Fixed a bug that would crash zephyr when renaming certain textured meshes
+ Fixed a Qt related memory issue in the log panel
+ Tiff file loading speedup (can be disabled in application options)
+ Minor UI fixes

* there has been an internal debate, whether should we use an additional decimal or the round up approximation. We went for the additional decimal value.

notes.title: 3DF Zephyr 3.0 goes Open beta!
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that 3DF Zephyr 3.0 is almost ready to ship! While we iron out the last remaining bugs and finish polishing the newest features, why don’t you help us out testing our latest build?

To download and test the beta go to: http://www.3dflow.net/3df-zephyr-3-0-goes-open-beta/

As usual, all technology improvements are common to all Zephyr’s flavors, and that obviously includes 3DF Zephyr Lite and Steam Edition. Enjoy the new faster global structure from motion pipeline, the new Mesh photo-consistent optimization and every other tweak we made under the hood! The 3.0 update will be free for all existing steam users!

A special announcement for our 3DF Zephyr Lite (both standard users and Steam) users :

- Advanced mode added to Zephyr Lite/Steam Edition 3.0

We feel that many Lite users can benefit a lot from our advanced settings (until now available only to Pro and Aerial users), so Lite versions are no longer locked to “preset mode” only. Enjoy more control over your reconstruction process!

notes.title: 3DF Zephyr 2.700 out now!
notes.content:
Good news, everyone!

3DF Zephyr 2.700 is out now! Below the full changelog:

3DF Zephyr 2.702 changelog (13th September)

- hotfix : Fixed a crash when importing certain e57 files 
- Improved point cloud normals rendering
- Stereo speed up volume + ordering stero point cloud before removal

3DF Zephyr 2.701 changelog (6th August)

- hotfix: Fixed a crash that may happen during texture generation 

3DF Zephyr 2.700 changelog (5th August)

- 3DF Zephyr is also a 3D model viewer (supported point clouds, mesh and textured mesh – ply, pts, ptx, xyz, obj+mtl, las, e57, dae, collada )
- Synchronized Camera Shooting beta (Supports Canon EOS DSLR only, Zephyr Lite up to 2 cameras)
- New point cloud streamed rendering
- It is now possible to edit animation keypoints using a visual gizmo
- It is now possible to extract frames from .mov files
- It is now possible to choose between JPG and PNG when extracting frames from videos
- SfM and MvS speed improvements
- Minor text fixes
- Added orthographic camera
- Added pivot central in pivot view mode
- Improved rendering for point clouds
- Improved point removal of point clouds
- Improved dump/crash report
- Improved noise removal procedure during MVS
- Improved camera selection dialogs
- Fixed some bugs in some formats import
- Fixed a bug that could appear when generating textures
- Fixed a bug that could appear on some multi-cpu configurations
- Fixed a bug with GPS exif reading
- Fixed a bug with undefined normals
- Fixed a bug occurring when using the Fast hole filling mesh filter
- Fixed a crash occurring when deleting SfM points and then adding cameras to the workspace
- Fixed a problem when using image names with some special characters (e.g. ì)
- Fixed a bug when dealing with Tiff files (exif fix)
- More miscellaneous bugfixes

notes.title: 3DF Zephyr 2.600 out now!
notes.content:
Good news, everyone!

3DF Zephyr 2.600 is now available for download! Your steam client will automatically download this update, as usual!

Among the many improvements and bugfixes, we're very happy to announce that now Zephyr Lite has the following features:

+ .fbx export for an easier, Steam VR development
+ mesh import with custom UV mapping
+ match viewer
+ new x-y axis aligment tool

Many technology improvements and bugfixes found their way in this new major update!

The full changelog can be found at http://www.3dflow.net/3df-zephyr-2-600-out-now/

Keep the feedback coming in!

- the 3Dflow staff
